description: Builds an UNSIGNED, pre-simulated Solana transaction for the given wallet that closes up to 20 empty token accounts (each returns ~0.002 SOL rent to the wallet) and revokes up to 8 token approvals. Fee: 10% of the reclaimed rent (included as a transfer in the transaction, shown in the response); revokes are free. The wallet owner must sign (base64 legacy transaction, fee payer = wallet) and send it. Call repeatedly for wallets with more than 20 empty accounts. Free DIY alternative: spl-token close --address <ACCOUNT>.

address.description: Wallet public key (base58) that will sign

burn_dust.description: Also burn token balances worth < $0.01 (or unpriced on Jupiter; never NFTs/stablecoins/majors) and close those accounts. Irreversible; default false.

name: wallet_cleanup_tx
title: Build wallet cleanup transaction (reclaim SOL rent)
